excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.GetName]内的博物天枢被摧毁了。

我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
excerpt.en:
Our Grand Archive in [from.GetName] has been destroyed.

Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

We'll need to rebuild the Grand Archive in another system to continue our Specimen exhibiti
